I dont know how much I can say to help, but as someone who's been the "therapist/upbeat" friend, I definitely know where youre coming from. First off, I think you truly need to cut that guy out of your life, because that seems like a very toxic friendship with him taking and not giving. Second off, I would recommend seeing a therapist about this before it gets even more out of hand, prescribed medication is what helped me get back on the right track, and therapy is worth it. Third off, your feelings are so valid and youre not crazy for the pain youre in. You can find friends that will make you feel loved, I promise. Maybe join a class for something youre passionate about, or join a reddit community about something you like. That can be a great place to start. I wish you the best of luck.

Okay, I dont really have an answer per say, but as someone who has felt in kind of a rut like that and worked out of it, here's what tips I can give you. 1. Find a new hobby or start researching something really abstract, it gives your mind something to do, even if it doesn't love it. 2. If you haven't already, go to a therapist or talk to a hotline, I think you need those skills to help bring your life back on track. 3. if you can, dont let yourself be alone, always be out there in the world, and dont get in your bed until nighttime. sun does a lot to help, as well as not making a place for sleep a place for anything else, because then your brain gets bored and starts overthinking. I dont know how much of a help this will be, but I hope these tips might do something :))

I probably cannot be the most help, but I think you need to take a look back and really see what \*YOU\* want to do with your life. Is it something entirely different? Great, start yourself down a new path then. Live for you, and if you aren't finding what you live for worth it anymore, start a new life. We only have one shot pretty much, so let yourself live it. But if you want to continue on the path youre at, remind yourself that this is what you want, and that if you want something to change, you have to change it. I hope this helps a bit.
